nonFederalNewOrRevisedAmount.title: New or revised non-federal budget
nonFederalNewOrRevisedAmount.description: Enter the non-federal share for the upcoming period. For a supplemental application, enter the additional contribution. For a change, enter the increase or decrease.

totalAmount.title: Total
totalAmount.description: Enter the total budgeted amount for this row. This value is not calculated automatically.
